audit_items.proof_trace: Any member that passes the DB lookup guard (L31–35) unconditionally reaches the verified-role block at L190–198, where the role is added if not already present. The only soft gap is silent no-op when DISCORD_VERIFIED_ROLE_ID is unset, which is an operational deployment concern. The positive direction of the invariant (DB-registered member receives verified role on successful sync) holds for all reachable paths.
